mainEntity.name: What should I consider regarding water pressure and plumbing during an upgrade?

acceptedAnswer.text: During a shower or tub upgrade, it's important to consider your existing water pressure and the condition of your plumbing. Older homes, common in areas like Berkeley and Oakland, might have outdated plumbing that could affect water flow or require upgrades to support new fixtures. We assess your current plumbing system during the initial site visit to identify any potential issues or necessary improvements to ensure optimal performance of your new shower or tub. This prevents future problems and ensures proper function.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider existing water pressure and plumbing condition, especially in older homes, during an upgrade. We assess your plumbing to ensure new fixtures perform optimally and prevent future issues.
